decision: What should the site icon be about, and in what style?

options.name: Black coffee
options.bet: The coffee-chat cup, top down. Every visitor already meets it on the desk.
options.risk: At 16px it is a white disc with a dark centre; could read as a generic 'record' or 'eye'.

options.name: Plop
options.bet: The sugar cube mid-drop, drawn in the cartoon style of the splash. Playful and ownable.
options.risk: Cartoon line style is new to the site's photographic desk; the cube alone reads as 'a box'.

options.name: Polaroid
options.bet: A tilted polaroid holding your own Cappadocia photo. Real media, not an illustration.
options.risk: A photo turns to colour noise at 16px; it only shines at 180px (home screen).

options.name: Savar. highlight
options.bet: Lifts the homepage's one brand moment: blue 'S.' on the highlighter, caught mid-beckon (-3°).
options.risk: Still a letter in a square. Closest to the current icon in kind, if not in feel.

options.name: Gel-pen s.
options.bet: A handwritten 's' in black gel ink on a notebook page: the pen you can pick up on the desk.
options.risk: Handwriting is thin; it needs a heavy stroke to survive at 16px and may look childish.

options.name: Sticker
options.bet: 'S.' as a die-cut vinyl sticker with a peeling corner.
options.risk: Peel detail is lost under 32px; at 16px it is B1 with a white edge.

options.name: RAZR screen
options.bet: A pixel 'S' with a blinking-cursor bar on the RAZR's navy screen. Built on a 16px grid, so it is the sharpest option in a tab.
options.risk: Retro pixel is a known trope; it carries the RAZR, not Savar.

options.name: Pixel ramen
options.bet: The Food object as 16x16 pixel art: bowl, egg, nori, chopsticks, steam. Warm and personal.
options.risk: Food icons are common on food sites; may say 'ramen blog' before it says 'Savar'.

options.name: Pixel coffee
options.bet: The coffee cup as pixel art with rising steam: the coffee-chat invite in a 16px tile.
options.risk: Coffee-cup favicons exist (cafes, Java). Less unique than the top-down A1.

options.name: Desk from above
options.bet: The whole homepage in miniature: notebook, folder, polaroid, and coffee scattered on a white desk.
options.risk: At 16px it is confetti. Meaning only lands for people who have seen the homepage.

options.name: Coffee ring
options.bet: A coffee ring left on paper: proof someone sat and worked here. Quiet, editorial, unlike any other favicon.
options.risk: Could read as a stain or a broken circle; brown on cream has low contrast in dark tab bars.

options.name: Stirred S
options.bet: Black coffee from above with the spoon's stir trail forming an 'S'. A monogram you notice second.
options.risk: If the swirl is too subtle it is just a coffee; too strong and it is latte art (and you take it black).
